fixture_correction.description: The initial 1024-byte receive buffer established a full kernel send queue but drained too slowly. The live test was explicitly interrupted and its fixture cleaned up. The corrected test uses a 32768-byte receive buffer, QUICKACK while draining, and a 15-second drain deadline. The interrupted experiment is not counted as a pass.

limits: Prioritization occurs only between complete frames and cannot bypass bytes already in the kernel.
Ordinary output has 16 records/1 MiB; callback output has 4 records/256 KiB. Active frames remain charged.
The real backpressure test depends on Linux /proc/net/tcp and is mandatory in the Linux GCC/Clang metadata matrix. Shared queue components run on GCC/Clang/MSVC.
Probe deadlines still start at creation; transport-send/deadline coordination remains open.
Durable owner recovery and production delegation handout remain open.
Remote acceptance for this change is pending.
